description: After a live chat or video session ends, or after a free question is answered, give the person a thumbs up or thumbs down (once). It feeds their public thumbs-up rate, which helps other agents choose. Pass session_id for a live session or question_id for an answer.

comment.description: Optional: a short reason (up to 500 characters).

rating.description: up: they helped; down: they did not.

name: rate_human
